image_description: A medium shot of a De Brazza's monkey (a type of guenon) sitting on a wooden post. The monkey has distinctive grey fur, black limbs, a white chest beard, and a bare face with a prominent orange crescent on the forehead and blueish nose. It is looking directly at the camera. The background is a soft-focus natural environment.

Eyes are forward-facing. Irises appear dark brown/black, consistent with the species.
The nose is narrow and elongated, typical of Old World monkeys, with a pale/blueish hue.
Ears are small and partially obscured by the facial ruff, but visible and proportionate.
